results.ask: How much is a boiler service?
results.reply: A boiler service is from £85 in this demo. For the exact cost of your job, please use the enquiry form on the Contact page or call 01632 960 472.

results.ask: Do you cover Westhill?
results.reply: Yes, Westhill is one of the areas we cover, along with Aberdeen and nearby places such as Bridge of Don and Cults. For a call-out, you can use Book a call-out or call us on 01632 960 472.

results.ask: What happens with the £25 deposit?
results.reply: The £25 deposit is paid when you book a call-out, and it comes off your final bill. If you cancel at least 24 hours before the appointment, it is refunded in full. To book, use the Book a call-out page, and if you need anything else, call 01632 960 472. This is a demo, so the payment uses test money only.

results.ask: What time do you open on a Saturday?
results.reply: On Saturdays we're open from 09:00 to 13:00. We're closed on Sundays, except for emergencies, which we cover 24 hours a day. For anything else, you can use the enquiry form on the Contact page or call 01632 960 472.

results.ask: Do you do 24-hour call-outs?
results.reply: Yes, emergency call-outs are available 24 hours a day, every day, for things like burst pipes and bad leaks. If you can, turn off the water at the stopcock first, then call us on 01632 960 472 or use the enquiry form on the Contact page.

results.ask: Can I cancel a booking and get my deposit back?
results.reply: Yes, you can cancel for free up to 24 hours before your appointment, and your £25 deposit is refunded in that case. To make a cancellation or check the details of your booking, please use the Contact page or call 01632 960 472.

results.ask: How far ahead can I book a call-out?
results.reply: You can book a call-out for any date from the next day up to 14 days ahead. To book, head to the Book a call-out page and pick a date and time window.
